title: Cargo hauling
summary: Buy commodities low at one TDD, sell high at another. Profit is spread per SCU minus fuel, time, and risk.
tips: Trade routes tab ranks spread by your cargo SCU with hauler presets.
Open Commodities for best buy and sell prices per SCU across Stanton.
Large ships (C2, Caterpillar, Hull series) scale profit with SCU.
Session Shopping tab logs kiosk purchases when Game.log records them.

title: Mining and selling
summary: Extract ore or harvest materials, refine when needed, then sell at TDDs. Sell price per SCU matters more than raw ore names.
tips: Market prices tab (Mining filter) lists extractable and harvestable goods with UEX sell prices.
Quantanium and volatile goods need fast routes after extraction.
Refined metals often sell better than ore variants listed at zero.
Crafting workshop shows which ores each blueprint needs and how quality shifts stats.

title: Support the Miners (Recco Battaglia)
summary: Alpha 4.9 Frontier Tensions introduces Recco Battaglia contracts — prospecting, mining support, recovery, salvage, and investigation work that builds People's Alliance standing in Nyx.
tips: Accept Recco Battaglia / Support the Miners contracts from your mobiGlas.
Rewards and standing unlock further opportunities; larger ship rewards continue into later patches.
Pair with Mining and Crafting tabs when contracts call for ores or materials.
Session Missions and Rewards tabs log contracts and payouts when Game.log records them.

title: Wikelo Emporium trades
summary: Barter materials, scrip, and Favors at Wikelo Emporium stations for ships, armor, weapons, and specialty gear.
tips: Wikelo trades tab lists trade-in items and rewards from star-citizen.wiki.
Favor contracts convert ores and scrip into Wikelo Favor for higher-tier trades.
Verify amounts in-game — datamine values can lag a patch.

title: Crafting blueprints
summary: Unlock schematics from missions, gather materials at the quality you want, then craft at a station. Material quality changes output stats.
tips: Crafting workshop lists mission sources, material amounts, and quality sliders per input.
Session Blueprints tab logs unlocks when Game.log names them.
Compare projected stats at Q500 baseline vs the ore you actually mined.

title: Smuggling
summary: Move illegal or restricted goods from low-security sources to buyers willing to pay a premium.
tips: Smuggler routes tab has curated Stanton loops with commodity hints.
Compare illegal commodity spreads in Commodities detail view.
Expect interdiction and scans near major ports.

title: Merc and bounty hunting
summary: Contracts, bunkers, and PvP bounties. StarTracker tracks missions, kills, deaths, and payouts from Game.log.
tips: Rewards tab shows confirmed aUEC or wiki estimates when the log omits cash.
Missions tab tracks Foxwell defend, Headhunters ambush, and other contracts.
Kills tab highlights PvP bounty completions.

title: Refuel and logistics
summary: Plan routes around ship services and commodity terminals before long hauls.
tips: Ship services catalog lists refuel, repair, and ammo restock locations.
Pair service stops with commodity terminals on the same moon when possible.
Insurance tab confirms claims after ship loss.
